question: Does simulated musculoskeletal walking from many simulated bodies, used as pre-training or mixed into training, lower the per-plate impulse forecast error for measured people never used before, compared with the same model trained on measured walks only, with the same update and tuning budgets?
claim_limits: Healthy adults of one public cohort walking overground in one laboratory; 100 ms ahead; four force plates.
No claim of generalisation to every body, clinical gait or other tasks.
Simulated, measured and derived values are labelled apart in files, model inputs and reports.
Surface EMG is not a nerve recording.
People, walks, traversals, issues, plate rows and onset events are counted separately; simulated bodies, walks and traversals separately from measured ones.

earlier_unpublished_test.design: 50% of fitting windows replaced by 5 simulated walks of one anatomy from the published learned MyoLeg policy
earlier_unpublished_test.scored_on: 6 treadmill walkers of another public cohort, already used in development

binding_items: walking-scale commit, sha256 of its PROTOCOL.json and of its allocation output
subject codes and files of the group reserved for physics-source (the test group)
subject codes of the walking-scale training people and sha256 of each cached walk reused
adapter file and sha256; forecaster family code and sha256; marker admission and causality guard; EMG qualification rule
inner-fold source by the coverage test only
S0 outputs by sha256: GATE-THRESHOLDS.json, FEASIBILITY.json, body pass register, generators passed
lists computed by fixed rules: inner folds of the full pool, narrow pool, G4 reference-walk assignment
dependency.inner_fold_coverage_test: walking-scale folds are used only if its committed protocol places every physics-source training person in exactly one of exactly four folds; otherwise the physics-source rule
dependency.other_changes: protocol version 2, separate admission and commit before any reserved byte is opened
dependency.if_not_committed: S5 does not run; S0-S4 reported as development results on training people only

data_sources.name: Van Criekinge healthy cohort

article.citation: Van Criekinge T. et al. Scientific Data 10, 852 (2023)

notes: plate force signs differ between files; the adapter normalises to upward positive
published markers are gap-filled and smoothed (not causal at 10 ms)

data_sources.name: myo_sim (MyoLeg)
data_sources.upstream: Rajagopal et al. 2016 full-body gait model, MIT, doi 10.1109/TBME.2016.2586891
data_sources.note: MyoLeg muscle and chain files identical in 0.2.3 and 0.2.5

components.torso: Bruno et al. 2015 lumbar spine, MIT

data_sources.name: published MyoLeg walking policy
data_sources.use: unscreened control and optional G2, private, scores only

people.training_bound_later: walking-scale training people (all rungs), reused read-only by sha256
people.test: physics-source group of the walking-scale allocation, copied into BINDING.json

other: walking-scale evaluation group and every walking-scale group other than its training people and the physics-source group
every other reserved group of the project

source_order: static trial (code 0) PROCESSING Bodymass, Height, LLegLength/RLegLength
static-trial markers: leg length ASIS-knee-ankle averaged over sides; height = highest head marker + 50 mm; mass missing
body_descriptors.body_weight_for_envelope: Bodymass x 9.81, else mean total plate force over >= 2 s quiet standing in the static trial, else excluded from BW features
body_descriptors.test_people: static trial read after the sealing conditions, as a declared issue-time input

test_group.rule: not allocated here; copied from the walking-scale allocation

inner_folds.rule: Rank training people by ascending sha256('physics-source-inner-v1|' + subject code); fold = rank mod 4. People added at binding (walking-scale training rungs) are ranked together with these 18 by the same rule, unless the coverage test in PROTOCOL.md section 4 selects the walking-scale folds.

data_efficiency_subsets.rule: For n in (3, 6, 12) and subset s in 0..4, rank the 18 people by ascending sha256('physics-source-subset-v1|' + s + '|' + subject code) and take the first n. n = 18 is the single set of all 18. The full pool (18 plus walking-scale training rungs) is the last point of the curve.

g4_reference_walks.rule: walk w of body B takes the training walk with the smallest sha256('physics-source-g4-ref-v1|' + body id + '|' + w + '|' + subject code + '|' + author trial index); in each inner fold, walks whose reference person is held out are left out

narrow_pool.rule: training people with leg length at or below the full-pool median

bodies.rule: Scrambled Sobol sequence in natural index order, 10 dimensions, Joe-Kuo direction numbers, linear matrix scramble plus digital shift with bits from sha256('physics-source-allocation-v1|sobol-scramble|seed20261127|dim' + d + '|block' + b). u = (integer + 0.5) / 2^32. Generators use prefixes: G1 B0000-B0127, G4 B0000-B0599, G3c B0000-B0031, G3f B0000-B0015; diversity series 1, 8, 32 and 128 bodies.

mapping.mass_kg: BMI = 18 + 16 u1; mass = BMI * stature^2, clipped to 45..115 kg (mass_clipped records it)
mapping.thigh_shank_ratio_factor: 1 + 0.12 (u2 - 0.5): thigh length times sqrt(f), shank length divided by sqrt(f)
mapping.strength_factor: (0.6 + 0.7 u5) * (mass / 75 kg)^(2/3), multiplies every muscle peak isometric force
mapping.vmax_l0_per_s: 8 + 4 u6, muscle maximum shortening velocity in optimal fibre lengths per second
mapping.contact_time_constant_s: 0.02 + 0.02 u7, MuJoCo solref time constant of foot-floor contacts
mapping.friction: 0.6 + 0.6 u8, sliding friction of foot-floor contacts
mapping.speed_factor: 0.8 + 0.45 u9; G1 target speeds = speed_factor * (0.9, 1.0, 1.1) * 1.25 m/s * sqrt(stature / 1.70), clipped to 0.95..1.70 m/s; G4 target speed = speed_factor * reference speed * sqrt(stature / reference stature), clipped to 0.95..1.70 m/s

task.source_of_definitions: walking-scale adapter, imported by sha256; the committed adapter governs
task.issue_grid: t = 199 + 20k on the native 1 kHz analog grid of each walk or traversal

force.what: ten non-overlapping 20 ms means of target-plate upward vertical force, samples t-199..t

inputs.markers: only if walking-scale admits them, under its causality guard (plate-centred heel and toe)
inputs.body_vector: optional (tuned): mass kg, height mm, leg length mm, missing flags
inputs.emg_secondary: walking-scale EMG feature rule, else within-channel relative change, median and 80th percentile across channels
inputs.variant_K: only if markers are not admitted: LHEE, RHEE, LTOE, RTOE in mm, plate-centred frame, walking direction from past sacrum progression, ten frames 20 ms apart ending at or before t - 100 ms

new_load.definition: unloaded plate (20 consecutive samples within -10..+10 N) then a rising +20 N crossing held for the next 19 samples, with onset in t+1..t+100; negative needs known state at t and coverage through t+119

impulse.definition: sum of upward vertical force over samples t+1..t+100 times 0.001 s

heel_secondary.definition: heel displacement t to t+100 ms, both heels, Euclidean, once per issue

task.eligibility: inputs and target-validity masks only, equal for every arm

environments.A: MuJoCo 3.17.0, MyoSuite 3.0.0, myo_sim 0.2.3: published policy (unscreened control, optional G2)
environments.B: MuJoCo 3.17.0, MyoSuite 3.1.0, myo_sim 0.2.5: G1, G4, virtual laboratory, body scaling
environments.D: MyoGen 0.11.0, NEURON 8.2.7, separate process: private MyoGen EMG
environments.T: PyTorch CPU FP32, scikit-learn, NumPy: training, issuing, scoring

virtual_lab.plates: Van Criekinge corners; layout repeats about every 3.5 m with offsets up to +-0.4 m along and +-0.1 m across
virtual_lab.plate_force: sum of foot-floor contact normal forces with contact point inside the plate, 1 kHz (= 1 ms step)
virtual_lab.noise: per-plate SD and offset from training-people unloaded stretches
checks: vertical impulse closure < 0.5% incl. tracking residual
no external force except logged residual
virtual_lab.markers: Plug-in Gait heel and toe sites, 100 Hz, 1-2 mm noise, low-pass at the S0-measured cutoff

simulation.scaling_engine: MjSpec; lengths, sites, contacts, masses, inertias, peak forces; length ranges recomputed; unit factors reproduce the unmodified compiled sha256

G4.method: IK of training-people markers, retarget, PD joint targets -> static optimisation over 80 muscles every 10 ms; pelvis residual capped at 10% BW and logged

G1.method: Song-Geyer reflex controller, CMA-ES population 24, <= 6000 rollouts nominal, <= 1200 per warm-started body; objective survival to 12 s - speed error - integral of activation cubed; no measured-data term

G1-cal.condition: only if neither G4 nor G1 passes

G3c.method: myofullbody without arm subtree plus rigid arm masses (de Leva: 2.71%, 1.62%, 0.61% per side), G4 tracker

mapping.ERS: torso muscles in G3c/G3f, masked elsewhere

CR-EMG.amplitude: quantile-mapped per channel to training-people RMS
CR-EMG.clean_room: author records not having read MyoGen source

realism_gate.data_derived_from: 18 known training people only, widened by 10%

per_walk.no_fall: pelvis > 0.6 x standing pelvis height and no non-foot floor contact for >= 8 s
per_walk.stance_time: median and >= 90% of stances within [0.9 x P1, 1.1 x P99] of training-people plate stance times

realism_gate.body_passes: at least 2 of its walks pass; only passing walks enter the corpus

per_generator.joint_box: >= 50% of simulated rows with 200 ms history mean >= 20 N inside the training-people P5-P95 box of mean force/BW, largest 20 ms bin/BW, impulse/BW (+ heel 180 ms displacement if markers admitted)
per_generator.onset_rate: per-plate onsets per traversal within training-people min-max

realism_gate.go_no_go: >= 128 distinct passing bodies from one clean generator (G4, G1 or G1-cal) meeting the corpus criteria and covering >= 80% of every factor range; G3c/G3f need >= 75% of their bodies passing; else G1-cal once; else stop, keep the test group sealed, publish the negative feasibility result

model.family: walking-scale committed forecaster family, imported by sha256 (draft: compact three-pass recurrent: causal conv k=3, GRU, shared GRU cell x3; heads new-load logit and impulse residual over persistence)
model.standardisation: measured training people of each fit, equal person weight, applied unchanged to simulated and augmented rows

optimiser.name: AdamW
optimiser.schedule: cosine with 5% warm-up; reset with a new warm-up at fine-tuning

seeds.issued_forecast: mean of the five seed forecasts

stages.A: 5 family recipes at width 64, body vector off
stages.B: A winner at width 24, at width 128, and at width 64 with body vector on

tuning.selection_score: impulse MAE pooled over held people of the 4 inner folds, people equal, five-seed mean forecast
tuning.brier_guard: ineligible if pooled Brier > family best + 0.002
tuning.ties: within 0.1% relative: fewer simulated/augmented updates, fewer total updates, smaller width, body vector off

S*.corpus: pooled clean generators that passed (generator -> body)

AUG*.method: mass factor k_m and leg factor k_l uniform in [1-r, 1+r]; force x k_m, time x sqrt(k_l), markers x k_l, body vector scaled; labels recomputed by the adapter; 20 copies per traversal

H-S.kind: trees with simulated rows and a source flag

specificity_controls.P-shuffle: simulated targets permuted across bodies within strata of plate state at issue and generator

arms: frozen NeuroTranslate 0.0 shared encoder with a new linear input layer (recorded as not run if incompatible)

unscreened_earlier_style.corpus: published policy, nominal body: (mass, traction) = (1,1), (0.9,1), (1.1,1), (1,1.2), (1.1,1.2); no gate

EMG.qualification: walking-scale rule, else named left and right BF, GAS, RF, ST, TA, VL present, unique, finite

secondary_arms.heel: only if markers admitted: added head in every neural arm
secondary_arms.variant_K: only if markers not admitted: M_K, S*_K

descriptive.generator_ablation: each passing generator alone (G3f, G2 private)

data_efficiency.curve: a + b * n^-c fitted to M

descriptive.body_shift: narrow pool training; out-of-range test people (leg length above narrow max) vs others
descriptive.distance: per-person gain vs Mahalanobis distance of height, mass, leg length, walking speed

baselines: fit prevalence of new load with force persistence (latest 20 ms mean x 0.1 s)
linear trend through the last five 20 ms means, integrated over 100 ms; prevalence for new load
ridge and logistic on the neural inputs, penalty from {0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10} by inner folds
heel constant velocity and stationary heel (heel target only)
published force specialist common-six.npz, force-only calculation, penalty chosen on the 6 earlier validation people
published compact three-pass checkpoint, unchanged, where its EMG streams are available (reported with EMG arms)

primary.name: per-plate impulse MAE
primary.weighting: issues within walk, walks within person, people equal; plates pooled within walk

metrics.brier: new load, same weighting, rows with a known label
reported: counts of people, walks, traversals, issues, plate rows, verified onsets
metrics.contrast: delta = mean over test people of error(arm) - error(M); r = delta / mean error(M)

HELPED: S* impulse MAE point estimate below force persistence and ridge
success_rule.PHYSICS-SPECIFIC: only after HELPED: upper 95% bound of delta_impulse(S* - AUG*) < 0; otherwise not separable from body-scaling augmentation
success_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise; report realised interval and MDE = 2.80 x SD / sqrt(n)
key_secondaries_holm_0.05: S* - M heel displacement MAE (if heel target exists)

floors.primary: >= 10 test people scoreable for impulse, >= 8 with both label classes; else descriptive

success_rule.reporting: every predeclared result, wins and losses; nothing changed after any test label is read
